verses.text: A song of ascents. I lift my eyes to the hills. Where’s my help coming from?
My help comes from the LORD, the one who made heaven and earth.
He won’t let your foot slip. The one who watches over you won’t doze off.
Look, the one who watches over Israel never dozes and never sleeps.
The LORD watches over you. He’s the shade right beside you.
The sun won’t harm you by day, and the moon won’t harm you by night.
The LORD will guard you from every evil. He’ll watch over your life.
The LORD will watch over you when you go out and when you come home, from now on and forever.
